📋 Custom Roles

⚙️ Configure Roles & Permissions

Define which panels each role can access and whether they can view or edit.

Panel / Page GREEN DIGITALS RAINBOW UMBRELLAS
No Access View Edit No Access View Edit

Set permissions separately for each company. Rio and Rainbow can have different access levels for the same role.

📖 Role Descriptions

Admin: Full access to all panels including user management. Can view, edit, and manage everything.
Auditing: Full view access to all panels for auditing purposes. Can view and edit all data.
Expense: Access only to Expense panel. Can view and modify expense records only.
Billing: Access to Invoice and Billing pages only. Can create and manage invoices.
Guest: Read-only access to all panels. Can view all data but cannot make any changes.

Database Backup
Backup

Downloads every collection from this application's database into one timestamped file. Keep it somewhere safe — this is the file you'd use with Restore below if anything ever needs undoing.

Restore
This replaces everything currently in the database with whatever is in the file you choose — every collection in this database. A file taken from a different application's database is refused. There is no undo except restoring an older backup. Take a fresh backup above first if you're not certain.
